snippet.title: Hi-Score Boi Official Trailer
snippet.description:
There is always that one goal of every gamer...that goal is to become the ULTIMATE gamer! It's time to pick up the controller, glue yourself to the couch and get ready! Start your journey, jam to awesome music and achieve the highest score!


Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283000/HiScore_Boi/
Available on itch.io: https://88domo.itch.io/hi-score-boi
Coming soon to PS4/VITA

Twitter: https://twitter.com/moonrysestudios
